title: SettlementDetail
description:
The settlement record, projected. Separate from [`RunRecord::termination`]
by construction (epic 12.4).

criteria_ref.description:
The immutable criteria record this settlement judged against. Absent on
legacy runs, which the kernel marks with a `legacy_unattributed_criteria`
basis token.

SettlementStanding.description:
Whether a *governed settlement* has been recorded for the item. Distinct
from execution: work can execute perfectly and settle as rejected.

oneOf.description: No settlement record exists for this item yet.
A settlement record accepted the work.
A settlement record rejected the work.
A settlement record escalated the decision to a human.
